requirement_text: The application must be fully loaded and ready to use within a maximum of 2 seconds after startup on supported Android and iOS devices.
requirement_reference: "It is particularly important to us that the app runs quickly and smoothly so that it is fully loaded and ready to use within a maximum of two seconds after starting."

user_story.story: As a mobile user, I want the app to be ready within 2 seconds after launch so that I can use it without delay.
user_story.Acceptance: Given the app is closed on a supported device, When I start the app, Then the application must be fully loaded and ready to use within 2 seconds.

requirement_text: The application must provide direct and easy access to information through the user interface.
requirement_reference: "The user interface is designed so that users can access the information in the app directly."

user_story.story: As a football fan, I want direct access to information in the interface so that I can find content easily.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I am using the app, When I navigate to major content areas, Then the interface must allow me to access the relevant information directly without unnecessary navigation steps.

requirement_text: All modules and the user interface must remain consistent even when external server updates occur.
requirement_reference: "All modules and the user interface are fixed components of the app and remain consistent even with external server updates."

user_story.story: As a user, I want the app interface and modules to remain consistent during external updates so that my experience is stable and predictable.
user_story.Acceptance: Given the external server data changes or updates, When the app receives updated data, Then the app’s modules and user interface structure must remain consistent and usable.

requirement_text: Registration and login shall be uncomplicated for users.
requirement_reference: "Registration and login are designed to be uncomplicated"

user_story.story: As a new or returning user, I want registration and login to be uncomplicated so that I can access the app easily.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I am at the startup authentication flow, When I attempt to register or log in, Then the process must be simple enough to complete without unnecessary steps or confusion.

requirement_text: The application must function reliably even with limited network coverage.
requirement_reference: "Therefore, the app is developed so that it functions reliably even with limited network coverage."

user_story.story: As a mobile user, I want the app to function reliably under limited network coverage so that I can still use it in poor connectivity conditions.
user_story.Acceptance: Given network coverage is weak or unstable, When I use the app, Then the application must continue operating reliably for supported features without crashing or becoming unusable.

requirement_text: The application must support up to 100,000 simultaneous users on high-traffic match days without performance loss.
requirement_reference: "On match days with a particularly high number of accesses, our app is designed so that up to 100,000 users can be served simultaneously without performance loss."

user_story.story: As a football fan, I want the app to remain performant during peak match-day traffic so that I can still access features when many others are using it.
user_story.Acceptance: Given a peak load of up to 100,000 simultaneous users, When users access the app on match day, Then the system must continue serving users without performance degradation beyond agreed operating thresholds.

requirement_text: The application must undergo thorough testing and support processes before release to detect and resolve malfunctions early.
requirement_reference: "To prevent technical problems, the app goes through a thorough testing and support process before release to detect and resolve any malfunctions early."

user_story.story: As a product owner, I want the app to undergo thorough pre-release testing and support so that malfunctions are identified and resolved early.
user_story.Acceptance: Given a planned release, When the release readiness process is executed, Then the app must complete the defined testing and support activities before release approval.

requirement_text: The system must process all personal data in compliance with the GDPR.
requirement_reference: "Data protection is our highest priority. All personal data of users are processed in compliance with the GDPR."

user_story.story: As a user, I want my personal data processed in compliance with GDPR so that my privacy rights are protected.
user_story.Acceptance: Given the system collects, stores, or processes personal data, When personal data processing occurs, Then the system must process that data in compliance with GDPR requirements.
